name: Data.heightPerRow_le
summary: Stirling bounds the jet size; the level prime N is chosen with log N ≥ λ, which cancels the main term m·a(w̄ + G) of the excesses; the rest is within the budget.

steps.claim: Put w̄ := (1/f_D)·∑_τ log w_D(τ), the mean of the log-weights over all infinite places.

steps.lean: set G := (D.gProd * D.rootDisc / (2 * π)).log with hG

steps.claim: Stirling: log a_D! ≤ a_D·log a_D − a_D + (1 + log a_D/2), from the monotonicity of log of Stirling's sequence n!/(√(2n)(n/e)^n) (its value at a_D is at most its value at 1), with a_D ≥ 1.
steps.lean:
have stirling : log D.a.factorial ≤ D.a * log D.a - D.a + (1 + log D.a / 2) := by
    have S := log_stirlingSeq'_antitone D.a.pred.zero_le
    simp [log_stirlingSeq_formula, log_div, log_mul, log_sqrt, (HasLogBound.pos D).ne',
      (D.nat_le_of_hasLogBound : 1 ≤ D.a)] at S
    bound
steps.typed_fact: log D.a.factorial ≤ D.a * log D.a - D.a + (1 + log D.a / 2)

steps.claim: The excess: jetSize_D(a_D) − Ask_main(D) ≤ a_D·(w̄ + G) + (1 + log a_D/2). Indeed jetSize_D(a_D) = log a_D! − a_D·log(Ω/g) with Ω = e^(ℓ(d))·2π/rd_E, and Ask_main(D) = a_D(log a_D − 1 − ℓ(d) − w̄), so the difference is log a_D! − a_D log a_D + a_D + a_D(G + w̄), and step 3 applies.
steps.lean:
have excess : D.jetSize D.a - D.mainAsk ≤ D.a * (w + G) + (1 + log D.a / 2) := by
    simp [jetSize, mainAsk, hG, bigOmega, log_div, log_mul, (HasLogBound.pos D).ne']
    bound
steps.typed_fact: D.jetSize D.a - D.mainAsk ≤ D.a * (w + G) + (1 + log D.a / 2)

steps.claim: The level: m_D·(w̄ + G) − (G + (15/2)·log b_D) ≤ log N_D, because the left side is λ_D = `Data.logLevelTarget` and λ_D ≤ log N_D (`Data.log_N_mem_window`).
steps.lean:
have level : D.m * (w + G) - (G + 15 / 2 * D.logB) ≤
    log D.N := by grind [D.log_N_mem_window.1, logLevelTarget]

steps.claim: h₀(D) ≤ h_main(D) − m_D·rem(D) + 𝓑(D), by the following chain.
steps.lean:
calc D.heightPerRow = D.mainHeight - D.m * D.remainder + #_ *
      (D.m * (D.jetSize D.a - D.mainAsk) - D.a * log D.N) := by
        simp [heightPerRow, mainHeight, remainder]
        ring
    _ ≤ D.mainHeight - D.m * D.remainder + #D.tops * (D.m * (_ + (1 + log D.a / 2)) -
        D.a * (_ - (G + _))) := by bound
    -- `m a (w + G)` cancels
    _ = _ + #D.tops * (D.m * (1 + log D.a / 2) + D.a * (G + 15 / 2 * D.logB)) := by ring
    _ ≤ _ := add_le_add_right D.le_of_hasLogBound _

steps.claim: h₀(D) = h_main(D) − m_D·rem(D) + #tops(D)·(m_D·(jetSize_D(a_D) − Ask_main(D)) − a_D·log N_D): unfold h₀, h_main = m·k·𝖴 and rem = ∑_τ (Ask(D, a_D, τ) − Ask_main(D)), and rearrange.
steps.lean:
calc D.heightPerRow = D.mainHeight - D.m * D.remainder + #_ *
      (D.m * (D.jetSize D.a - D.mainAsk) - D.a * log D.N) := by
        simp [heightPerRow, mainHeight, remainder]
        ring

steps.claim: … ≤ h_main(D) − m_D·rem(D) + #tops(D)·(m_D·(a_D(w̄ + G) + (1 + log a_D/2)) − a_D·(m_D(w̄ + G) − (G + (15/2)log b_D))), by steps 4 and 5 (all factors are non-negative).
steps.lean:
_ ≤ D.mainHeight - D.m * D.remainder + #D.tops * (D.m * (_ + (1 + log D.a / 2)) -
        D.a * (_ - (G + _))) := by bound

steps.claim: … = h_main(D) − m_D·rem(D) + #tops(D)·(m_D·(1 + log a_D/2) + a_D·(G + (15/2)·log b_D)): the terms m_D·a_D·(w̄ + G) cancel.
steps.lean: _ = _ + #D.tops * (D.m * (1 + log D.a / 2) + D.a * (G + 15 / 2 * D.logB)) := by ring

steps.claim: … ≤ h_main(D) − m_D·rem(D) + 𝓑(D), by the size comparison (`Data.le_of_hasLogBound`): #tops(D)·(m_D(1 + log a_D/2) + a_D(G + 7.5·log b_D)) ≤ f_D·a_D·(log b_D)³.
